title: Emerging skills and wage gaps in the low-carbon transition: evidence from online job vacancy data
title_zh: 低碳转型中的新兴技能与工资差距：来自在线招聘数据的证据
title_primary: 低碳转型中的新兴技能与工资差距：来自在线招聘数据的证据
title_secondary: Emerging skills and wage gaps in the low-carbon transition: evidence from online job vacancy data
authors: Aurélien Saussay, Misato Sato, Francesco Vona
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-09-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Standard occupational classifications obscure identifying which jobs directly con tribute to decarbonization. Using U.S. online job vacancy data, we develop a trans parent, skill-based approach that identifies low-carbon jobs within occupations, by combining advanced natural language processing with text linked to established green classifications. We show that low-carbon job creation is more prevalent in low-skilled occupations, yet low-carbon jobs systematically require more complex skill sets than comparable generic jobs in the same occupations. These higher skill requirements are associated with a modest wage premium that declines over time and is largely driven by firm fixed effects. Reskilling patterns and low-carbon wage premia vary substantially across occupations, and the latter are markedly smaller than the high-carbon wage premia, especially in STEM occupations. Finally, low carbon jobs are more spatially correlated with high-carbon employment than just renewable energy jobs, but are also more prevalent in wealthier areas.
abstract_zh: 标准职业分类难以明确识别哪些工作直接促进脱碳。利用美国在线职位空缺数据，我们开发了一种透明、基于技能的方法，通过结合先进自然语言处理与既定绿色分类相关文本，识别职业内部的低碳工作。研究表明，低碳岗位创造更多集中于低技能职业，然而低碳工作系统性地要求比同一职业中类似普通岗位更复杂的技能组合。这些更高的技能要求与适度的工资溢价相关，该溢价随时间递减，且主要由企业固定效应驱动。技能重塑模式与低碳工资溢价在不同职业间差异显著，且后者明显小于高碳工资溢价，尤其在STEM职业中。最后，低碳工作与高碳就业的空间相关性高于仅可再生能源岗位，但低碳工作在更富裕地区也更为普遍。

source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-09-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper develops an empirical model to predict episodes of debt servicing difficulties (“debt distress”) in low-income countries, with three main contributions to the existing literature. First, it develops more refined measures of external debt distress episodes that allow timing the onset of distress episodes with increased precision. Second, it develops a systematic algorithm to comprehensively assess the out-of-sample predictive performance of more than 550,000 candidate binary prediction models using J-K-fold cross-validation. Third, it tests whether more sophisticated machine learning algorithms can outperform simple probit models. The paper finds that simple single-equation probit models have better predictive power for debt distress than more sophisticated algorithms and are comparable in terms of predictive performance to important policy benchmarks such as the IMF and World Bank debt sustainability framework for low-income countries.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个实证模型，用以预测低收入国家债务偿付困难（“债务困境”）的阶段，对现有文献有三项主要贡献。第一，它开发了更为精细的外债困境阶段度量方法，使得能够更精确地确定困境阶段的起始时间。第二，它设计了一套系统性算法，通过J-K折交叉验证，全面评估超过55万个候选二元预测模型的样本外预测性能。第三，它检验了更为复杂的机器学习算法是否能超越简单的概率单位模型。研究发现，简单的单方程概率单位模型在预测债务困境方面优于更复杂的算法，并且在预测性能上与诸如国际货币基金组织和世界银行针对低收入国家的债务可持续性框架等重要政策基准相当。

title: Colonial legacies: Shaping African cities
title_zh: 殖民遗产：塑造非洲城市
title_primary: 殖民遗产：塑造非洲城市
title_secondary: Colonial legacies: Shaping African cities
authors: Neeraj Baruah, J. Vernon Henderson, Cong Peng
official: 官方在线 2020-09-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Institutions persisting from colonial rule affect the spatial structure and conditions under which 100’s of millions of people live in Sub-Saharan African cities. In a sample of 318 cities, Francophone cities have more compact development than Anglophone, overall, in older colonial sections, and at clear extensive margins long after the colonial era. Compactness covers intensity of land use, gridiron road structures, and leapfrogging of new developments. Why the difference? Under British indirect and dual mandate rule, colonial and native sections developed without coordination. In contrast, integrated city planning and land allocation were featured in French direct rule. These differences in planning traditions persist.
abstract_zh: 殖民时期延续下来的制度影响着撒哈拉以南非洲城市中数亿人口居住的空间结构与环境条件。在对318个城市的样本分析中，法语区城市相较于英语区城市，在整体上、老殖民区域以及殖民时代结束很久后的明显扩展边缘地带，均展现出更为紧凑的发展形态。紧凑性涵盖土地利用强度、棋盘式道路结构以及新开发区域的跳跃式扩展情况。为何存在这种差异？在英国间接统治及双重委任统治下，殖民区与本地区域的发展缺乏协调。相反，法国直接统治则强调统一的城市规划与土地分配。这些规划传统的差异延续至今。

abstract: Post-pandemic inflation raised fears that U.S. monetary tightening would trigger a repeat of the 1982 sudden stop in capital flows to emerging economies. Yet as of 2026 no global recession has followed. We establish three stylized facts distinguishing the 1980s from the 2020s, beyond the shift to flexible exchange rates: monetary policy effectiveness, fiscal space, and external vulnerabilities. We rationalize them in a Mundell-Fleming framework with a fiscal space constraint, which predicts a central role for fiscal space in transmitting foreign currency risk-free rate increases. Cross-country evidence confirms that fiscal space shapes economic performance post-tightening.
abstract_zh: 疫情后的通胀引发了人们的担忧，即美国货币紧缩将重演1982年新兴经济体资本流入的突然停止。然而，截至2026年，全球并未出现衰退。我们确立了三个典型事实，用以区分1980年代与2020年代，除了转向浮动汇率制之外：货币政策有效性、财政空间和外部脆弱性。我们在一个包含财政空间约束的蒙代尔-弗莱明框架中对其进行了合理化解释，该框架预测财政空间在传导外币无风险利率上升中发挥核心作用。跨国证据证实，财政空间塑造了紧缩后的经济表现。

official: 官方在线 2026-08-24 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: CaliforniaÕs Proposition 12 (Prop 12) regulations prohibit certain practices related to the sale of pork within the state and little is known about the demand-side implications. This study uses publicly available survey data and a random utility framework to estimate the welfare loss experienced by Californians in the pork chop and bacon markets. We find that 6.3 and 4.4 percent of California households exit the pork chop and bacon markets, respectively, as a result of Prop 12-related price increases. In aggregate, the state experiences annual consumer welfare losses of $47.5 million on pork chops and bacon.

authors: Jessica Piccolo, Yuriy Gorodnichenko, Selva Demiralp, Orkun Saka, Michael Weber 等
official: 官方在线 2025-03-29 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines how homeownership status shapes attention to inflation and its impact on durable consumption. Using randomized controlled trials on U.S. households (2021–2023), we document systematic heterogeneity in responses to inflation-related information. Homeowners exhibit greater baseline awareness and update their expectations less than renters. Exploiting exogenous variation in inflation expectations induced by the treatments, we find that homeowners adjust durable spending significantly, whereas renters do not. These results highlight homeownership as a key factor in the formation of inflation expectations and their influence on economic behavior.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了住房所有权状态如何影响对通货膨胀的关注及其对耐用品消费的影响。通过对美国家庭（2021-2023年）进行随机对照试验，我们记录了与通胀相关信息反应中的系统性异质性。房主表现出更高的基线认知度，并且其预期调整幅度小于租户。利用由实验处理引起的外生通胀预期变化，我们发现房主显著调整耐用品支出，而租户则未作调整。这些结果凸显了住房所有权在通胀预期形成及其对经济行为影响中的关键作用。

title: Macroprudential policy may curb innovation – but instrument choice matters

official: 官方在线 2026-08-11 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Macroprudential policy is designed to make the financial system safer, but it can also reshape the finance available to innovative firms. Using patent data matched to 2,844 firms in 21 European countries over 1990-2021, this column finds that macroprudential tightening is followed by lower patenting and lower patent quality. The effect is strongest when credit growth is weak and among financially constrained firms, and it is concentrated in instruments that directly restrict credit. By contrast, financial-resilience tools carry no measurable short-run innovation cost and may support innovation over longer horizons. The findings suggest that policymakers can protect financial stability without systematically penalising innovation, provided they are selective about which instruments they deploy.
abstract_zh: 宏观审慎政策旨在提升金融体系的安全性，但同时也可能重塑创新型企业可获得的融资环境。本文利用1990年至2021年间覆盖21个欧洲国家2844家企业的专利数据，发现宏观审慎政策的收紧伴随着专利申请数量及专利质量的下降。这一效应在信贷增长疲软时期及面临融资约束的企业中尤为显著，且主要集中在直接限制信贷的工具上。相比之下，金融韧性工具在短期内未带来可测的创新成本，并可能在更长时期内支持创新活动。研究结果表明，政策制定者能够在保障金融稳定的同时，避免系统性抑制创新，前提是审慎选择所采用的工具类型。

title: College, Cognitive Ability, and Socioeconomic Disadvantage: Policy Lessons from the U.K. in 1960–2004

title_primary: 大学、认知能力与社会经济劣势：1960—2004年英国的政策启示
title_secondary: College, Cognitive Ability, and Socioeconomic Disadvantage: Policy Lessons from the U.K. in 1960–2004
authors: Andrea Ichino, Aldo Rustichini, Giulio Zanella
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-07 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: University access has significantly expanded in OECD countries, and further growth figures prominently in political agendas. We study possible consequences of historical and future expansions in a stochastic, general equilibrium Roy model where tertiary educational attainment is determined by cognitive ability and socioeconomic disadvantage. In our analysis, individual productivity depends not only on education but also directly on cognitive ability. The expansion of university access in the U.K. that started in the 1960s provides an ideal case study to draw lessons for the future. We find that this expansion led to the selection into college of progressively less talented students from advantaged backgrounds. Appropriate counterfactual policies existed that would have achieved the dual goal of increasing college graduates’ cognitive ability while improving tertiary education opportunities for the disadvantaged.
abstract_zh: 在OECD国家，大学入学机会已显著扩大，且进一步增长在政治议程中占据突出位置。我们研究历史和未来扩张在随机、一般均衡罗伊模型中的可能后果，其中高等教育成就由认知能力和社会经济劣势决定。在我们的分析中，个体生产力不仅取决于教育，还直接取决于认知能力。英国自20世纪60年代开始的大学入学扩张为未来提供了理想案例研究。我们发现，这一扩张导致来自优势背景的学生中，能力逐渐较低者被选拔进入大学。存在适当的反事实政策，本可实现增加大学毕业生认知能力与改善弱势群体高等教育机会的双重目标。

title_primary: 解读国际金融中的动荡时期
title_secondary: Interpreting Turbulent Episodes in International Finance
authors: Rey, Helene, Stavrakeva, Vania
official: 官方在线 2026-07-27 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the anatomy of the international portfolio finance network. As global financial linkages have become denser over time, cross-border portfolio equity positions have grown in importance relative to debt for Emerging markets and Advanced economies. Using the framework developed by Stavrakeva and Rey (2024), we construct a novel proxy of daily foreign investor holdings in both equity and long-term sovereign debt markets across 32 currency areas. Leveraging an instrumental variable strategy, we identify an effect of foreign equity ETF inflows on exchange rates and local stock market prices. Our high-frequency proxy enables us to interpret episodes of turbulence in international finance. It should prove useful to assess how persistent the current shocks to the international financial system are likely to be.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了国际组合金融网络的结构。随着全球金融联系日益紧密，跨境组合股权头寸在新兴市场和发达经济体中的重要性相对于债务持续上升。基于Stavrakeva与Rey（2024）构建的分析框架，我们创新性地构建了涵盖32个货币区域的股票及长期主权债券市场每日外国投资者持有量的代理指标。通过工具变量策略，我们识别出外国股权ETF资金流入对汇率及本地股票市场价格存在显著影响。这一高频代理指标使我们能够解读国际金融市场的动荡时期，并为评估当前国际金融体系冲击的持续性提供分析工具。

title: DP747 What to Expect from Regional and Multilateral Trade Negotiations: A Public Choice Perspective

authors: Michael P Leidy, Bernard Hoekman, Mitsuo Inada, Naoto Jinji, Taiyo Yoshimi 等
official: 官方在线 1993-01-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper develops an analytical structure for assessing the process of international trade negotiations that includes interest groups and self-interested negotiators as fundamental elements. The central conclusion of the analysis is that it is likely to be very difficult for a government that wishes to promote national welfare to do so. The political economy analysis suggests there are strong incentives facing politicians to produce agreements whose profile appears distinctly liberalizing while significant protectionist character flaws tend to be buried in the esoterica. The primary need is to design institutions that will help to introduce much greater transparency in both regional and multilateral agreements and thereby encourage the mobilization of diffuse consumer interests. Only then will significant progress towards liberalization - whether regional or multilateral - become more likely.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析国际贸易谈判进程的分析框架，将利益集团与自利型谈判者作为核心要素。分析的核心结论是：试图提升国民福利的政府很可能难以实现这一目标。政治经济学分析表明，政治家面临强烈激励去达成表面呈现显著自由化特征、而重大保护主义缺陷往往深藏于晦涩条款中的协议。当务之急是设计有助于提升区域及多边协议透明度的制度安排，从而激励分散的消费者利益群体形成合力。唯有如此，无论是区域还是多边层面的自由化进程才更有可能取得实质性突破。

title: Generalized Autoregressive Score Trees and Forests
title_zh: 广义自回归得分树与森林
title_primary: 广义自回归得分树与森林
title_secondary: Generalized Autoregressive Score Trees and Forests
authors: Andrew J. Patton, Yasin Simsek
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose methods to improve the forecasts from generalized autoregressive score (GAS) models (Creal, et al., 2013; Harvey, 2013) by localizing their parameters using decision trees and random forests. These methods avoid the curse of dimensionality faced by kernel-based approaches, and allow one to draw on information from multiple state variables simultaneously. We apply the new models to four distinct empirical analyses, and in all applications the proposed new methods significantly outperform the baseline GAS model. In our applications to stock return volatility and density prediction, the optimal GAS tree model reveals a leverage effect and a variance risk premium effect. Our study of stock-bond dependence finds evidence of a flight-to-quality effect in the optimal GAS forest forecasts, while our analysis of high-frequency trade durations uncovers a volume-volatility effect.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一些方法，通过决策树和随机森林对广义自回归得分（GAS）模型（Creal等，2013；Harvey，2013）的参数进行局部化处理，以改进其预测。这些方法避免了基于核方法所面临的维度灾难问题，并允许同时利用多个状态变量的信息。我们将新模型应用于四项不同的实证分析中，在所有应用中，所提出的新方法均显著优于基准GAS模型。在股票收益波动率和密度预测的应用中，最优GAS树模型揭示了杠杆效应和方差风险溢价效应。我们对股票-债券依赖性的研究发现，最优GAS森林预测中存在避险效应，而对高频交易持续时间的分析则揭示了成交量-波动率效应。

title: Which Green Technology to Subsidize? Evidence from Electric Vehicles in South Korea
title_zh: 补贴哪种绿色技术？来自韩国电动汽车的证据
title_primary: 补贴哪种绿色技术？来自韩国电动汽车的证据
title_secondary: Which Green Technology to Subsidize? Evidence from Electric Vehicles in South Korea
authors: Frank Verboven, Youngjin Hong, In Kyung Kim
official: 官方在线 2026-07-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop a framework to compare the relative effectiveness of subsidizing alternative emission-reducing technologies. We show that an intermediate technology may reduce emissions more effectively than the cleanest technology if it induces sufficiently greater substitution away from the prevailing high-emission technology. We apply the framework to the South Korean passenger vehicle market using a demand model that incorporates mileage heterogeneity, an important determinant of fuel-type choice. First, reallocating existing subsidies from battery electric vehicles (BEVs), the cleanest technology, to hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs), an intermediate technology, would reduce total greenhouse gas emissions by an additional 47\%. Second, for a BEV-focused subsidy policy to outperform an HEV-focused policy, the carbon intensity of electricity generation would need to fall by approximately 45\%. Our findings suggest that HEV subsidies remain more effective than BEV subsidies until consumers become sufficiently willing to switch to BEVs or electricity generation becomes sufficiently decarbonized.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析框架，用于比较补贴不同减排技术的相对有效性。研究表明，若中间技术能显著促使消费者从当前高排放技术转向该技术，其减排效果可能优于最清洁技术。我们将该框架应用于韩国乘用车市场，采用了一个考虑里程异质性（影响燃料类型选择的关键因素）的需求模型。研究发现：第一，将现有补贴从最清洁的纯电动汽车（BEV）重新分配至中间技术的混合动力汽车（HEV），可使温室气体总排放量额外降低47%；第二，若要使以BEV为核心的补贴政策效果优于以HEV为核心的政策，电力生产的碳强度需下降约45%。结论表明，在消费者对BEV的转换意愿足够强烈或电力生产实现充分脱碳之前，HEV补贴始终比BEV补贴更有效。

title: General Equilibrium Effects in Space: Theory and Measurement
title_zh: 空间中的一般均衡效应：理论与测度
title_primary: 空间中的一般均衡效应：理论与测度
title_secondary: General Equilibrium Effects in Space: Theory and Measurement
authors: Adão, Rodrigo, Arkolakis, Costas, Esposito, Federico
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Macroeconomics · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: We examine the general-equilibrium effect of the China shock on US regions. We demonstrate that spatial linkages intensify the shock’s negative impact on employment across regions, leading to differential effects that are substantially larger than predictions from existing quantitative models. To address this disconnect, we develop a reduced-form representation of the impact of trade shocks in spatial models. Regional responses combine the direct effect of local shock exposure and its indirect spatial effects. Our approach extends shift-share empirical strategies and indicates that employment losses were amplified by strong agglomeration forces, large employment sensitivity to wages, and spatial and production linkages.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了中国冲击对美国各区域的一般均衡效应。研究表明，空间关联加剧了该冲击对各区域就业的负面影响，导致差异化效应显著大于现有量化模型的预测结果。为解释这一偏差，我们构建了空间模型中贸易冲击影响的简化形式表征。区域响应融合了本地冲击暴露的直接效应及其间接空间效应。本方法拓展了偏移份额实证策略，并揭示出就业损失因强集聚效应、就业对工资的高敏感性以及空间与生产关联而被放大。

title: Luck of the Draw: The Causal Effect of Physicians on Birth Outcomes
title_zh: 抽签的运气：医生对分娩结果的因果效应
title_primary: 抽签的运气：医生对分娩结果的因果效应
title_secondary: Luck of the Draw: The Causal Effect of Physicians on Birth Outcomes
authors: Posso, Christian, Tamayo, Jorge, Guarin, Arlen, Saravia, Estefania
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper studies whether more skilled physicians improve birth outcomes. We exploit a natural experiment in Colombia, where newly graduated physicians were randomly assigned to Local Health Centers (LHCs), to estimate the causal effect of being treated by a more skilled physician—measured using medical graduation exam scores—on newborn health. We find that mothers treated at LHCs assigned physicians with exam scores one standard deviation higher were 9.14 percent less likely to give birth to an unhealthy newborn. Suggestive evidence indicates that more skilled physicians achieve these results by better targeting prenatal care toward high-risk mothers without reducing care for others.
abstract_zh: 本文研究技能更高的医生是否能改善新生儿健康结局。我们利用哥伦比亚的一项自然实验——新毕业医生被随机分配到地方健康中心（LHCs）——来估计由技能更高医生（以医学毕业考试成绩衡量）接诊对新生儿健康的因果效应。研究发现，在分配了考试成绩高一个标准差的医生的LHCs就诊的母亲，其分娩不健康新生儿的概率降低9.14%。初步证据表明，技能更高的医生通过更精准地将产前护理资源向高风险母亲倾斜（同时不减少对其他母亲的护理）来实现这些结果。

title: The Social Value of Hurricane Forecasts
title_zh: 飓风预报的社会价值
title_primary: 飓风预报的社会价值
title_secondary: The Social Value of Hurricane Forecasts
authors: Molina, Renato, Rudik, Ivan
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: What is the impact and value of hurricane forecasts? We study this question using the universe of landfalling US hurricanes between 2005–2022. We find that forecasts drive adaptive protective expenditures, and that erroneous underforecasts result in a significant increase in total hurricane damage. Using a theoreticallygrounded approach for estimating the marginal value of forecast improvements, we find that improvements since 2007, after the implementation of a national policy to improve hurricane forecasts, have reduced total costs by 19%, averaging $2 billion per hurricane. These benefits far exceed the annual budget of the policy and of all federal weather forecasting.
abstract_zh: 飓风预报的影响与价值何在？我们以2005年至2022年间登陆美国的所有飓风为研究对象，发现预报能够驱动适应性防护支出，而错误的低估预报会导致飓风总损失显著增加。通过基于理论的方法估算预报改进的边际价值，我们发现自2007年实施国家飓风预报改进政策以来，预报质量的提升使总成本降低了19%，平均每次飓风减少20亿美元损失。这些收益远超该政策年度预算及联邦所有气象预报的年度总投入。

title: 教育回报、收入差距与父母教养方式选择
title_zh: 教育回报、收入差距与父母教养方式选择
title_primary: 教育回报、收入差距与父母教养方式选择
authors: 吴贾, 刘亚淇, 黄子彬, 楚鹏飞
official: 官方发布 2026-07-10 · 来源：CNKI RSS
abstract: 本文分析了我国权威型教养方式背后的社会经济动因,其与社会教育回报率和地区收入差距有直接联系。本文利用2005年人口抽样调查和多项微观调查数据,研究发现父母在26-40岁经历的教育回报率每提高1个百分点,其采取权威型教养方式的概率将提高1.21个百分点。地区收入差距会进一步扩大教育回报率对教养方式选择的影响,因为在收入差距越大的地区,父母越有动力严格要求子女,提高其教育水平,从而实现社会经济地位向上流动。机制分析表明,高教育回报率会增强父母对教育价值的认同和对子女的学历期望。本文还分析了权威型教养方式的积极影响及其可能产生的成本。本研究为理解家庭养育中的“内卷”行为提供了经济学解释。

title: Losses from a Disability: Temporal Variety and Earnings in the Long Run
title_zh: 残疾导致的损失：长期中的时间变化与收入
title_primary: 残疾导致的损失：长期中的时间变化与收入
title_secondary: Losses from a Disability: Temporal Variety and Earnings in the Long Run
authors: Daniel S. Hamermesh
official: 官方在线月份 2026-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using diaries covering 25-61-year-olds in the American Time Use Survey 2009-24, this study demonstrates that temporal variety—doing more different things in a day—is income superior. Linking these data to underlying Current Population Surveys, propensity-score models show that people stating that they have a mobility/physical disability in each of two consecutive annual surveys undertake almost 4 percent fewer activities per day than other, demographically identical individuals. They also earn about 50 percent less. Combining the estimated impact of income on temporal variety with the implied reductions in variety incurred by those with the disability yields a monetary equivalent of lost variety exceeding that of lost earnings. Measuring disability status only once yields much smaller estimated shortfalls in temporal variety and earnings. That suggests that one-time self-reports of disabilities, which underlie the bulk of studies on the impacts of disabilities on earnings, also underestimate long-term effects.
abstract_zh: 本研究利用2009-2024年美国时间使用调查中25-61岁人群的日记数据，证明时间多样性（即一天内从事更多不同活动）具有收入优越性。通过将这些数据与基础当前人口调查相关联，倾向得分模型显示，在连续两次年度调查中均报告存在行动/身体残疾的个体，其每日活动数量比人口统计学特征相同的其他群体少近4%，收入也低约50%。将收入对时间多样性的估计影响与残疾群体所承受的多样性减少幅度相结合，得出多样性损失的货币等价物超过了收入损失。仅单次测量残疾状态时，时间多样性和收入缺口的估计值显著偏小。这表明，基于单次自我报告残疾状态（多数残疾对收入影响研究的基础）会低估长期效应。

title: The Economics of Marriage Payments: Bride Price, Dowry, and Dower
title_zh: 婚姻支付的经济学：聘礼、嫁妆与寡妇产
title_primary: 婚姻支付的经济学：聘礼、嫁妆与寡妇产
title_secondary: The Economics of Marriage Payments: Bride Price, Dowry, and Dower
authors: Siwan Anderson
official: 官方在线 2026-06-30 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Marriage payments are transfers made in connection with marriage and are among the most widespread and enduring institutions in human history. They can be categorized into three forms: bride price, paid by the groom or his family to the bride’s parents; dowry, transferred from the bride’s family to the groom or his kin; and dower, paid by the groom directly to the bride and retained as her property. Although their prevalence has declined in many industrialized societies, marriage payments remain common across large parts of Asia, Africa, the Middle East, and Oceania. Their persistence reflects the fact that they serve multiple economic and social functions simultaneously. Marriage payments can facilitate matching in marriage markets, redistribute marital surplus, transfer wealth across generations, provide insurance within marriage, and signal status, prestige, and adherence to social norms. Marriage payments influence a wide range of outcomes, including household savings, fertility decisions, child marriage, educational investments, migration, bargaining power within marriage, and marital stability. Their effects often extend beyond the married couple themselves, shaping intergenerational patterns of wealth transmission and human capital formation. As such, the consequences of marriage payments are far-reaching. Their welfare implications depend critically on the direction of transfers, who retains control over them after marriage, and the broader legal and social institutions in which they are embedded. In some settings, marital transfers can enhance women’s economic security and bargaining power. In others, they may contribute to gender inequality, violence, coercion, son preference, and constraints on women’s autonomy. The significance of these welfare consequences warrants the attention of policymakers. Accordingly, marriage payments have generated considerable debate and ongoing efforts toward legal reform. At the same time, the diversity of marriage payment systems suggests caution in the design of public policy. Blanket prohibitions or externally imposed reforms may overlook the multiple functions these institutions perform and may generate unintended consequences. More promising approaches may focus on mitigating specific harmful features while preserving functions that families value, particularly where marriage payments remain deeply embedded in local social, economic, and legal systems.
abstract_zh: 婚姻支付是与婚姻相关的财产转移，是人类历史上最普遍且最持久的制度之一。其形式可分为三类：聘礼，由新郎或其家庭支付给新娘父母；嫁妆，从新娘家庭转移给新郎或其亲属；以及聘金，由新郎直接支付给新娘并作为其个人财产保留。尽管在众多工业化社会中婚姻支付的盛行程度有所下降，但在亚洲、非洲、中东和大洋洲的大部分地区，婚姻支付仍然普遍存在。其持续性反映了这些支付同时服务于多种经济和社会功能。婚姻支付可以促进婚姻市场中的匹配、重新分配婚姻剩余、实现代际财富转移、在婚姻内部提供保险，并传递地位、声望及对社会规范的遵从。婚姻支付影响广泛的结果，包括家庭储蓄、生育决策、童婚、教育投资、迁移、婚姻内部议价能力以及婚姻稳定性。其影响往往超越夫妻本身，塑造代际财富传递模式和人力资本形成。因此，婚姻支付的后果具有深远影响。其福利效应关键取决于转移的方向、婚后谁保留对转移财产的控制权，以及这些支付所嵌入的更广泛的法律和社会制度。在某些情境下，婚姻转移可以增强女性的经济安全和议价能力；在其他情境下，则可能加剧性别不平等、暴力、胁迫、男孩偏好以及对女性自主权的限制。这些福利后果的重要性值得政策制定者关注。相应地，婚姻支付引发了大量争论和持续的法律改革努力。同时，婚姻支付体系的多样性提示公共政策设计需谨慎。全面禁止或外部强加的改革可能忽视这些制度所履行的多重功能，并可能产生意外后果。更有前景的方法可能是聚焦于减轻特定有害特征，同时保留家庭所珍视的功能，尤其是在婚姻支付仍深深嵌入当地社会、经济和法律体系的地区。

title: Graphical Copula GARCH Modeling with Dynamic Conditional Dependence
title_zh: 基于动态条件依赖的图形Copula GARCH建模
title_primary: 基于动态条件依赖的图形Copula GARCH建模
title_secondary: Graphical Copula GARCH Modeling with Dynamic Conditional Dependence
authors: Lupe Shun Hin Chan, Amanda Man Ying Chu, Mike K. P. So
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Modeling returns on large portfolios is a challenging problem as the number of parameters in the covariance matrix grows as the square of the size of the portfolio. Traditional correlation models, for example, the dynamic conditional correlation (DCC)-GARCH model, often ignore the nonlinear dependencies in the tail of the return distribution. In this paper, we aim to develop a framework to model the nonlinear dependencies dynamically, namely the graphical copula GARCH (GC-GARCH) model. Motivated from the capital asset pricing model, to allow modeling of large portfolios, the number of parameters can be greatly reduced by introducing conditional independence among stocks given some risk factors. The joint distribution of the risk factors is factorized using a directed acyclic graph (DAG) with pair-copula construction (PCC) to enhance the modeling of the tails of the return distribution while offering the flexibility of having complex dependent structures. The DAG induces topological orders to the risk factors, which can be regarded as a list of directions of the flow of information. The conditional distributions among stock returns are also modeled using PCC. Dynamic conditional dependence structures are incorporated to allow the parameters in the copulas to be time-varying. Three-stage estimation is used to estimate parameters in the marginal distributions, the risk factor copulas, and the stock copulas. The simulation study shows that the proposed estimation procedure can estimate the parameters and the underlying DAG structure accurately. In the investment experiment of the empirical study, we demonstrate that the GC-GARCH model produces more precise conditional value-at-risk prediction and considerably higher cumulative portfolio returns than the DCC-GARCH model.

title_primary: 生态工业园区、绿色创新与绿色出口绩效：来自中国的证据

authors: Cui Hongxia, Yang Gaoju, Pu Long
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines how Eco‐industrial Parks (EIPs) in China shape firm green innovation and, furthermore, explores its implications for trade competitiveness. We find that EIPs significantly boost green patent applications, particularly substantive innovations. This effect is stronger in cleaner industries, environmentally stringent cities and firms with high media exposure. Mechanisms include eased financing constraints, and increased R&D investment. Extending the analysis to the trade domain, we further show that EIP‐induced green innovation enhances firms' performance in green exports. Thus, EIPs serve as a pivotal policy that fosters green innovation and cultivates competitive advantages in global green markets.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了中国生态工业园区（EIPs）如何影响企业绿色创新，并进一步探讨其对贸易竞争力的启示。我们发现，生态工业园区显著促进了绿色专利申请，尤其是实质性创新。这一效应在清洁行业、环境规制严格的城市以及媒体曝光度高的企业中更为显著。其作用机制包括缓解融资约束和增加研发投入。将分析拓展至贸易领域后，我们进一步表明，生态工业园区引致的绿色创新提升了企业在绿色出口方面的绩效。因此，生态工业园区作为一项关键政策，能够促进绿色创新，并在全球绿色市场中培育竞争优势。

title: Markets Mitigate Land‐Use Competition From Energy Crops and Increase Farm Revenues
title_zh: 市场缓解能源作物对土地利用的竞争并提高农场收入
title_primary: 市场缓解能源作物对土地利用的竞争并提高农场收入
title_secondary: Markets Mitigate Land‐Use Competition From Energy Crops and Increase Farm Revenues
authors: Daniel G. De La Torre Ugarte, Matthew H. Langholtz, Chad M. Hellwinckel
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ABSTRACT Meeting the US Sustainable Aviation Fuel Grand Challenge target of 35 billion gal annually by 2050 will require an estimated 380 million–700 million dry tons of agricultural biomass feedstock. This study evaluates the implications of large‐scale biomass production for land use, crop production, and market outcomes under mature market conditions. Results suggest that producing 476 million–843 million dry tons of biomass annually from agriculture would reduce cropland planted in corn, wheat, and soy by 8%–14%. However, convergence toward higher‐quality cropland raises per‐acre yields by 2%–9% relative to a business‐as‐usual baseline, limiting net production losses to 1%–3%. At the same time, farm market incomes increase by 20%–33%, whereas food price impacts remain below 1%. These findings indicate that substantial expansion of agricultural biomass for sustainable aviation fuel can be achieved with relatively modest impacts on food production and prices while also improving farm income.
abstract_zh: 摘要 为达成美国可持续航空燃料宏伟挑战中至2050年每年350亿加仑的目标，预计需要3.8亿至7亿干吨的农业生物质原料。本研究评估了在成熟市场条件下，大规模生物质生产对土地利用、作物生产和市场结果的影响。结果显示，每年从农业中生产4.76亿至8.43亿干吨生物质将使玉米、小麦和大豆的种植面积减少8%至14%。然而，向更高质量农田的集中使得每英亩产量相对于常规基线提高2%至9%，从而将净产量损失限制在1%至3%之间。同时，农场市场收入增加20%至33%，而食品价格影响保持在1%以下。这些发现表明，可持续航空燃料所需农业生物质的大幅扩张可以在对食品生产和价格影响相对较小的情况下实现，同时还能提升农场收入。

title: Consequences of land retirement policies on agricultural labor and land tenure: Evidence from the historical Conservation Reserve Program in the United States
title_zh: 土地休耕政策对农业劳动力和土地保有权的影响：来自美国历史性保护储备计划的证据
title_primary: 土地休耕政策对农业劳动力和土地保有权的影响：来自美国历史性保护储备计划的证据
title_secondary: Consequences of land retirement policies on agricultural labor and land tenure: Evidence from the historical Conservation Reserve Program in the United States
authors: Aparna Howlader, Liqing Li
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Voluntary agricultural land retirement programs are widely recognized for their environmental benefits, yet their economic effects, particularly on labor markets and land tenure, remain less understood. This paper examines the short‐ and long‐term impacts of the first large‐scale US land retirement initiative, the historical Conservation Reserve Program, introduced under the 1956 Set‐Aside Act. Between 1957 and 1960, the program enrolled more than 30 million acres under 3‐, 5‐, or 10‐year contracts, which then expired gradually through 1970. Using a newly digitized Conservation Reserve Program enrollment database linked to agricultural census data from the 1950s through the 1970s, we find that counties with medium and high enrollment intensity experienced statistically significant declines in tenant‐cultivated land relative to low‐enrollment counties during the program's active years. In medium‐enrollment counties, tenant‐operated land declined by roughly 0.6 percentage points, while high‐enrollment counties experienced declines of approximately 1.6 percentage points nationally. The proportion of tenant farm operators also fell in both medium‐ and high‐enrollment counties. These effects were larger and more persistent in the South, especially in counties with higher shares of nonwhite farm operators and sharecropping.
abstract_zh: 自愿性农业土地休耕项目因其环境效益而广受认可，但其经济影响——特别是对劳动力市场和土地保有权的影响——仍鲜为人知。本文考察了美国首个大规模土地休耕计划——1956年《预留法案》下设立的历史性保护储备计划——的短期与长期影响。1957年至1960年间，该计划以3年、5年或10年合同形式纳入了超过3000万英亩土地，这些合同随后于1970年前逐步到期。通过将新数字化的保护储备计划登记数据库与20世纪50年代至70年代的农业普查数据相关联，我们发现：在项目活跃期，中等和高强度登记县相对于低登记县，租佃耕地面积出现了统计上显著的下降。在全国范围内，中等登记县的租佃经营土地面积下降约0.6个百分点，而高登记县则下降约1.6个百分点。中等和高登记县的租佃农场经营者比例也同步下降。这些效应在南方地区更为显著且持久，尤其在非白人农场经营者及分成制佃农比例较高的县份表现突出。

title: Regularization of Synthetic Controls for Policy Evaluation
title_zh: 政策评估中合成控制法的正则化
title_primary: 政策评估中合成控制法的正则化
title_secondary: Regularization of Synthetic Controls for Policy Evaluation
authors: Yi‐Ting Chen
official: 官方在线 2026-05-27 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a unified framework for interpreting and comparing a broad class of synthetic control (SC) methods. Our framework is built on an analysis of a mean‐squared prediction error (MSPE) bound for the counterfactual predicted by a generic SC method, without imposing a specific outcome model. Using this framework, we develop a generalized SC method that provides a more comprehensive regularization of the MSPE bound than several existing SC methods. Through simulation studies and placebo analyses, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in predicting the counterfactual.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个统一框架，用于解释和比较广泛类别的合成控制（SC）方法。该框架基于对通用SC方法预测的反事实均方预测误差（MSPE）边界的分析，且无需设定特定结果模型。利用此框架，我们开发了一种广义合成控制方法，相较于现有多种SC方法，该方法对MSPE边界实现了更全面的正则化。通过模拟研究与安慰剂分析，我们验证了所提方法在反事实预测中的有效性。

title: Firm Responses to Hiring and Investment Subsidies: Regression Discontinuity Evidence from the California Competes Tax Credit
title_zh: 企业应对招聘与投资补贴的反应：来自加州竞争税收抵免的断点回归证据
title_primary: 企业应对招聘与投资补贴的反应：来自加州竞争税收抵免的断点回归证据
title_secondary: Firm Responses to Hiring and Investment Subsidies: Regression Discontinuity Evidence from the California Competes Tax Credit
authors: Benjamin Hyman, Matthew Freedman, Shantanu Khanna, David Neumark
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-14 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine firm responses to state hiring and investment subsidies. We leverage institutional features of the California Competes Tax Credit (CCTC), a large-scale business incentive program that incorporates best practices from prior job creation policies. The CCTC award selection procedure combines formula-based and discretionary components. Leveraging applicant score eligibility cutoffs in a regression discontinuity design and taking advantage of rich longitudinal microdata on establishments and their parent firms, we find that businesses expand employment in California in response to CCTC awards. There is little evidence that these expansions come at the expense of firms’ operations in other states. Our results suggest that targeted and audited hiring and investment subsidies can be effective in promoting local business expansions without inducing significant cross-state displacement effects.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了企业对州级雇佣与投资补贴的响应。我们利用加州竞争税收抵免（CCTC）的制度特征——这一大规模商业激励计划整合了以往就业创造政策的最佳实践。CCTC奖项评选程序结合了公式化与自由裁量两种机制。通过运用断点回归设计，基于申请者评分资格临界值，并借助涵盖企业及其母公司的丰富纵向微观数据，我们发现企业因获得CCTC奖项而在加州扩大了就业规模。几乎没有证据表明这种扩张是以牺牲企业在其他州的运营为代价。我们的研究结果表明，经过精准定位与审计的雇佣及投资补贴，能够有效促进本地企业扩张，且不会引发显著的跨州替代效应。

title: Weak-instrument-robust subvector inference in instrumental variables regression: A subvector Lagrange multiplier test and properties of subvector Anderson-Rubin confidence sets
title_zh: 工具变量回归中弱工具变量稳健的子向量推断：子向量拉格朗日乘子检验与子向量安德森-鲁宾置信集的性质
title_primary: 工具变量回归中弱工具变量稳健的子向量推断：子向量拉格朗日乘子检验与子向量安德森-鲁宾置信集的性质
title_secondary: Weak-instrument-robust subvector inference in instrumental variables regression: A subvector Lagrange multiplier test and properties of subvector Anderson-Rubin confidence sets
authors: Malte Londschien, Peter Bühlmann
official: 官方在线 2026-05-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We propose a weak-instrument-robust subvector Lagrange multiplier test for instrumental variables regression. We show that it is asymptotically size-correct under a technical condition. This is the first weak-instrument-robust subvector test for instrumental variables regression to recover the degrees of freedom of the commonly used non-weak-instrument-robust Wald test. Additionally, we provide a closed-form solution for subvector confidence sets obtained by inverting the subvector Anderson-Rubin test. We show that they are centered around a k-class estimator. Also, we show that the subvector confidence sets for single coefficients of the causal parameter are jointly bounded if and only if Anderson's likelihood-ratio test rejects the hypothesis that the first-stage regression parameter is of reduced rank, that is, that the causal parameter is not identified. Finally, we show that if a confidence set obtained by inverting the Anderson-Rubin test is bounded and nonempty, it is equal to a Wald-based confidence set with a data-dependent confidence level. We explicitly compute this Wald-based confidence test.
abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种针对工具变量回归的弱工具变量稳健子向量拉格朗日乘数检验。我们证明，在技术性条件下，该检验渐近地具有正确的规模。这是首个能够恢复常用非弱工具变量稳健Wald检验自由度的弱工具变量稳健子向量检验。此外，我们提供了通过反转子向量Anderson-Rubin检验所得子向量置信集的闭式解。我们证明这些置信集以k类估计量为中心。同时，我们表明，对于因果参数的单个系数的子向量置信集，当且仅当Anderson似然比检验拒绝了第一阶段回归参数为降秩（即因果参数未被识别）的假设时，这些置信集才是联合有界的。最后，我们证明，如果通过反转Anderson-Rubin检验获得的置信集是有界且非空的，则它等于一个具有数据依赖置信水平的基于Wald的置信集。我们明确计算了这一基于Wald的置信检验。

title: Transparency upon request: the right to pay information and the gender pay gap
title_zh: 应要求透明：薪酬知情权与性别薪酬差距
title_primary: 应要求透明：薪酬知情权与性别薪酬差距
title_secondary: Transparency upon request: the right to pay information and the gender pay gap
authors: Katharina Brütt, Huaiping Yuan
official: 官方在线 2026-04-28 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Pay transparency measures are widely adopted policy instruments to decrease the gender pay gap. This paper studies a policy that grants access to wage information only upon request, analysing a German pay transparency law that grants workers the right to request information about the earnings of colleagues in comparable positions. Using large-scale administrative data and exploiting variation in exposure to the policy due to an exogenous cut-off in firm size, we investigate the causal impact of this pay transparency policy. Wages and the gender wage gap in treated firms were unaffected. The right to request wage information alone, that is, the endogenous access to wage information, is not an effective policy tool. These findings are robust, with no detectable effects in firms where pay transparency may be particularly powerful.
abstract_zh: 薪酬透明度措施是缩小性别薪酬差距的广泛采用的政策工具。本文研究了一项仅在提出请求时才授予工资信息获取权的政策，分析了德国一项薪酬透明度法律，该法律赋予工人请求了解可比职位同事收入信息的权利。利用大规模行政数据，并利用企业规模外生截断点导致的政策暴露差异，我们考察了这项薪酬透明度政策的因果影响。受处理企业的工资和性别薪酬差距未受影响。仅凭请求工资信息的权利，即对工资信息的内生获取，并非有效的政策工具。这些发现具有稳健性，在薪酬透明度可能尤为有效的企业中，也未检测到任何效应。

title: Labor supply responses to tax credit disbursements: Evidence from the EITC schedule
title_zh: 税收抵免发放对劳动供给的反应：来自EITC计划的证据
title_primary: 税收抵免发放对劳动供给的反应：来自EITC计划的证据
title_secondary: Labor supply responses to tax credit disbursements: Evidence from the EITC schedule
authors: Andrew J. Bibler
official: 官方在线 2026-04-14 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) schedule and lump-sum disbursement can create significant labor supply responses. I estimate labor supply responses to tax credit disbursements using a regression kink design. Among single workers, credits increase labor supply around the time that tax credits are disbursed at the first and second kinks in the EITC schedule but reduce labor supply on the intensive margin at the third kink. There is some evidence of heterogeneous responses among married women, including an increase in labor supply near the third kink, although findings in the sample of married women appear less robust.
abstract_zh: 劳动所得税抵免（EITC）的税率结构和一次性发放可能引发显著的劳动力供给反应。我采用回归扭结设计估计税收抵免发放对劳动力供给的影响。在单身劳动者中，税收抵免在EITC税率表第一和第二扭结处发放时增加了劳动力供给，但在第三扭结处则减少了集约边际上的劳动力供给。已婚女性样本中存在异质性反应的证据，包括在第三扭结附近劳动力供给增加，尽管已婚女性样本中的结果似乎不够稳健。
